messages.subject: aroma.affymetrix v0.4.5 released
parts:
Hi,

aroma.affymetrix v0.4.5 is available.

Previous version (v0.4.4) introduced a bug that prevented probe
affinities to be saved when fitting probe-level models. Effectively
all probe affinities became zero and downstream calculations of
residuals would result in all infinities.

See group page for installation instructions. For more details on
updates in this new version, see the package's HISTORY file.

Cheers

Henrik
